Kept: N(gold) does not match ^-?\d+$ (gold taken from the e72c row; both files hold the same gold) and score_v3 == 1 in both files. Indicator: N(extracted_v3) == N(gold); empty extracted_v3 counts 0. Statistic: RL mean minus base mean. N follows the recipe in order: strip \boxed{} only if it wraps the whole string (outer whitespace ignored for this check), remove $, whitespace, \left, \right, \displaystyle, \, \! \; ^\circ ^{\circ}, map \dfrac and \tfrac to \frac, drop one trailing '.', take the text after the last '=' unless <, >, \le or \ge appear. Substring removal is literal, so for example '\right' is also removed from inside '\rightarrow'. Golds that are decimals like '0.5' or that hold LaTeX count as non-integer, as do golds like '+3' or '3.0'. alt_measured: the same difference with raw strings (extracted_v3.strip() == gold.strip(), no normalisation). An empty kept set is reported as not computable (the difference is undefined). The kept set is probably small (tens of problems), so one problem moves the number by several points.
